12.text: An online store is offering two different discounts on its sweaters: a bulk discount for large orders and a coupon discount. For orders of n sweaters, where 10 < n < 50, a bulk discount of n% off the original price of $44 is applied to the price of each sweater. If a coupon is applied to the order, a discount of an additional $3 is applied to the price of each sweater, after the bulk discount is applied. For a certain order with both the bulk discount and the coupon discount applied, the total price after the discounts for the sweaters purchased was $834. How many sweaters were purchased in this order?

13.text: An entomologist is studying the growth rate of various insect species in a controlled environment. For one particular species being studied in the controlled environment, an exponential model predicts that a population with an initial measurement of 8 organisms will increase by 160% every 24 days. Which equation represents this model, where y is the predicted number of organisms in the population x days since the initial measurement?

14.text: In the figure, line LQ intersects line MP at point R, and line LM is parallel to line PQ. The lengths of MR, LR, and RP are 9, 10, and 13, respectively. What is the length of LQ?

15.text: The scatterplot shows data set A. Data set B is created by multiplying the y-value of each data point from data set A by 30. Which of the following equations is the most appropriate model for data set B?

16.text: The data value 16 was recorded in error and is removed from data set A to create data set B, which consists of the remaining 40 data values. Which statement best compares the median of data set A and the median of data set B?

choices.A: The median of data set B is less than the median of data set A.
choices.B: The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A.
choices.C: The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A.
choices.D: There is not enough information to compare the medians of the two data sets.
